title: Frank-Wolfe Beyond 1/t Convergence
summary: We consider smooth convex minimization over compact convex sets, i.e., $\min_{x \in C} f(x)$ with the (vanilla) Frank-Wolfe algorithm. Well-known lower bounds establish a worst-case $Ω(1/t)$ primal-gap barrier in the general smooth convex case, and faster convergence usually requires favorable function properties such as Hölder error bounds or strong convexity.
